finding_text: Use of ingredients not intended for pharmaceutical use in non-sterile drug production.
finding_text_ko: 비무균 의약품 제조에 의약품용으로 의도되지 않은 원료를 사용했다.

finding_text: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not fully followed.
finding_text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)에 적용되는 책임과 절차를 완전히 준수하지 않았다.

finding_text: (Repeat) There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy, the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet any of its specifications whether or not the batch has been already distributed.
finding_text_ko: (반복 지적) 설명되지 않은 불일치(discrepancy), 그리고 배치 또는 그 구성 성분이 규격에 적합하지 않은 사례를 해당 배치의 출하 여부와 관계없이 철저히 검토하지 않았다.

finding_text: Failure to conduct media fills that closely simulate aseptic production operations under the worst-case, most-challenging, and stressfol conditions.
finding_text_ko: 최악 조건(worst-case)에서 가장 까다롭고 가혹한 조건으로 무균공정(aseptic) 제조 작업을 밀접하게 모사하는 배지충전(media fill)을 수행하지 않았다.

finding_text: (Repeat) Your firm failed to perform operations within specifically defined areas of adequate size and to have separate or defined areas or such other control systems necessary to prevent contamination or mix-ups in aseptic processing areas.
finding_text_ko: (반복 지적) 적절한 규모로 명확히 구획된 구역 내에서 작업을 수행하지 않았고, 무균공정(aseptic processing) 구역에서 오염 또는 혼동을 방지하는 데 필요한 분리·구획된 구역이나 그 밖의 관리 체계를 갖추지 않았다.

finding_text: Personnel were observed touching equipment or other surfaces located outside of the ISO S area with gloved hands and then proceeding with aseptic processing without changing or sanitizing gloves.
finding_text_ko: 작업자가 장갑을 낀 손으로 ISO 5 구역 밖의 장비나 그 밖의 표면을 접촉한 뒤, 장갑을 교체하거나 소독하지 않고 무균공정(aseptic processing)을 계속 수행하는 것이 관찰됐다.

finding_text: Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile are not followed.
finding_text_ko: 무균이라고 표방하는 의약품의 미생물 오염을 방지하기 위해 마련된 절차를 준수하지 않았다.

finding_text: Hazardous drugs were produced without providing adequate containment, segregation, and/or cleaning of work surfaces, utensils, and/or personnel to prevent cross-contamination.
finding_text_ko: 교차오염을 방지하기 위한 적절한 봉쇄(containment), 구획, 작업대·기구·작업자에 대한 세척 조치 없이 위해성 의약품(hazardous drugs)을 제조했다.

finding_text: Hazardous drugs were produced without providing adequate containment.
finding_text_ko: 적절한 봉쇄(containment) 조치 없이 위해성 의약품(hazardous drugs)을 제조했다.

finding_text: There is a failure to thoroughly review any unexplained discrepancy and the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet any of its specifications whether or not the batch has been already distributed.
finding_text_ko: 설명되지 않은 불일치(discrepancy), 그리고 배치 또는 그 구성 성분이 규격에 적합하지 않은 사례를 해당 배치의 출하 여부와 관계없이 철저히 검토하지 않았다.

finding_text: Your firm released drug product in which the strength differs from, or its purity or quality falls below, that which it purports or is represented to possess.
finding_text_ko: 표방하거나 표시된 것과 함량이 다르거나, 순도 또는 품질이 그에 미치지 못하는 의약품을 출하했다.

finding_text: Smoke studies were inadequately perfomed under dynamic conditions.
finding_text_ko: 동적 조건(dynamic conditions)에서의 기류가시화 시험(smoke study)을 부적절하게 수행했다.

finding_text: Each component is not tested for confonnity with all appropriate written specifications for purity, strength, and quality.
finding_text_ko: 각 원료가 순도·함량·품질에 대한 모든 해당 문서화된 규격에 적합한지 시험하지 않았다.

finding_text: Materials were exposed to lower than ISO 5 quality air.
finding_text_ko: 자재가 ISO 5 등급에 미치지 못하는 공기에 노출됐다.

finding_text: (Repeat) Your firm failed to establish and follow appropriate written procedures that are designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile, and that include validation of all aseptic and sterilization processes.
finding_text_ko: (반복 지적) 무균이라고 표방하는 의약품의 미생물 오염을 방지하기 위한 적절한 문서화된 절차, 즉 모든 무균공정(aseptic) 및 멸균공정의 밸리데이션을 포함하는 절차를 수립하고 준수하지 않았다.

finding_text: Your outsourcing facility compounds drug products using bulk drug substances that cannot be used in compounding under section 5038 because they (a) are not used to compound drug products that appear on the drug shortage list in effect under section 506E of the Act and (b) do not appear on a list developed by FDA of bulk drug substances for which there is a clinical need.
finding_text_ko: 귀사의 외주조제시설(outsourcing facility)은 section 5038에 따라 조제에 사용할 수 없는 원료의약품(bulk drug substance)을 사용해 의약품을 조제하고 있다. 해당 원료의약품은 (a) Act section 506E에 따라 시행 중인 공급부족 의약품 목록(drug shortage list)에 등재된 의약품의 조제에 사용되지 않으며, (b) FDA가 임상적 필요(clinical need)가 있다고 인정해 작성한 원료의약품 목록에도 등재되어 있지 않다.

finding_text: (Repeat) Buildings used in the manufacture, processing, packing, or holding of a drug do not have the suitable construction and location to facilitate cleaning, maintenance, and proper operations.
finding_text_ko: (반복 지적) 의약품의 제조·가공·포장·보관에 사용되는 건물이 세척, 유지관리 및 적절한 작업이 용이하도록 적합하게 구조화되거나 배치되어 있지 않다.

finding_text: Personnel were observed conducting aseptic manipulations where the movement of"first air" in tHE ISO 5 area is blocked or disrupted.
finding_text_ko: 작업자가 ISO 5 구역에서 first air(1차 공기)의 흐름이 차단되거나 교란된 상태로 무균조작(aseptic manipulation)을 수행하는 것이 관찰됐다.

finding_text: Personnel inadequately sanitized gloves to prevent contamination.
finding_text_ko: 작업자가 오염을 방지하기 위한 장갑 소독을 부적절하게 수행했다.

finding_text: Materials were exposed to lower than ISO 5 quality air.
finding_text_ko: 자재가 ISO 5 등급에 미치지 못하는 공기에 노출됐다.

finding_text: There is a failure of the quality control unit to secure their responsibility and authority to approve or reject all components, drug product containers, closures, in-process materials, packaging material, labeling.
finding_text_ko: 품질관리부서(quality control unit)가 모든 원료, 의약품 용기, 마개, 공정중간품, 포장재, 표시기재를 승인 또는 불합격 처리할 책임과 권한을 확보하지 못했다.

finding_text: Inadequate post-use filter-integrity testing on filters used to sterilize drug products.
finding_text_ko: 의약품 멸균에 사용한 필터에 대한 사용 후 필터 완전성 시험(filter integrity test)이 부적절했다.

finding_text: No deficiencies were recorded.
finding_text_ko: 기록된 지적사항이 없다.

finding_text: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 우수의약품제조·품질관리기준(GMP) 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The equipment was not set-up, designed, operated, stored, and/or maintained to prevent potential contamination of drugs by other drugs and/or by foreign material.
finding_text_ko: 장비가 다른 의약품이나 이물질에 의한 의약품 오염 가능성을 방지하도록 설치·설계·운전·보관·유지관리되지 않았다.

finding_text: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검 및 적격성평가(qualification)가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 공급자, 제조자, 시험자, 포장자, 표시기재자, 유통업자, 수입자, 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및 관리가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.
finding_text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.
finding_text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 체계가 변경사항의 적절한 문서화, 평가, 승인을 보장하기에 부적절했다.

finding_text: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 우수의약품제조·품질관리기준(GMP) 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The assessment, documentation, and/or procedures for considering the resale of returned drugs were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 반품 의약품의 재판매 검토에 대한 평가, 문서화 및 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및 후속조치가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The annual product quality review procedure was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 연간제품품질평가(annual product quality review) 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.
finding_text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 체계가 변경사항의 적절한 문서화, 평가, 승인을 보장하기에 부적절했다.

finding_text: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug. The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및 절차가 부적절했다. 온도 및 습도 관리가 부적절했다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및 후속조치가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.
finding_text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 체계가 변경사항의 적절한 문서화, 평가, 승인을 보장하기에 부적절했다.

finding_text: The written procedures for recalls were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 회수(recall)에 관한 문서화된 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures.
finding_text_ko: 품질관리부서가 GMP 문서 및 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인하거나 서명·날짜 기재하지 않았다.

finding_text: The maintenance of evidence was inadequate for manufacturing, packaging, labelling, required testing, storage, and/or distribution, including the respective conditions. Documents were not available on the premises.
finding_text_ko: 제조, 포장, 표시기재, 필수 시험, 보관, 유통 및 각각의 조건에 관한 증빙의 유지관리가 부적절했다. 문서를 사업장 내에서 확인할 수 없었다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및 후속조치가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The evidence required to demonstrate compliance with finished product specifications was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 완제품 규격 적합성을 입증하는 데 필요한 증빙이 부적절했다.

finding_text: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 공급자, 제조자, 시험자, 포장자, 표시기재자, 유통업자, 수입자, 도매업자 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및 관리가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The ongoing stability program for a drug was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 의약품에 대한 지속적 안정성시험 프로그램(ongoing stability program)이 부적절했다.

finding_text: The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 사전 승인된 문서화된 절차 또는 지시에 따른 원료, 제품, 포장재의 취급이 부적절했다.

finding_text: The quality control department did not approve, sign, and/or date the good manufacturing practices documents and/or the standard operating procedures. The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 품질관리부서가 GMP 문서 및 표준작업지침서(SOP)를 승인하거나 서명·날짜 기재하지 않았다. GMP 관련 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 관리가 부적절했다.

finding_text: A preventative maintenance system had not been established for the equipment used in significant processing and/or testing operations The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 주요 공정 및 시험 작업에 사용되는 장비에 대한 예방정비(preventive maintenance) 체계가 수립되어 있지 않았다. 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검 및 적격성평가(qualification)가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The written self-inspection procedure was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 문서화된 자체점검(self-inspection) 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 불만(complaint) 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가, 기록, 후속조치 및 조사가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The positive identification of each batch of drug after the packaging and/or after it was received on the importer's premises was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 포장 이후 및 수입자 사업장 입고 이후 각 의약품 배치의 확인(positive identification)이 부적절했다.

finding_text: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 제조공정, 장비 및 자재에 대한 평가가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 전산화 시스템을 포함한 장비의 교정, 점검 및 적격성평가(qualification)가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions. The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.
finding_text_ko: 세척절차의 실행, 효과성 및 밸리데이션이 비위생적 상태를 방지하기에 부적절했다. 위생관리 프로그램이 오염 위험을 식별하고 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.

finding_text: The quality control department's documentation, labelling, and/or quarantining of raw materials, packaging materials, in-process drugs, and/or bulk drugs was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 품질관리부서의 원료, 포장재, 공정중간 의약품, 벌크 의약품에 대한 문서화, 표시 및 격리보관(quarantine)이 부적절했다.

finding_text: The specifications approved by the quality control department were not available for all raw materials used to produce drugs.
finding_text_ko: 의약품 제조에 사용되는 모든 원료에 대해 품질관리부서가 승인한 규격이 구비되어 있지 않았다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate. The assessment, recording, follow-up, and/or investigation of complaints and/or other information about potentially defective products was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및 후속조치가 부적절했다. 불만(complaint) 및 결함 가능성이 있는 제품에 관한 그 밖의 정보에 대한 평가, 기록, 후속조치 및 조사가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The validation and/or the documentation of test methods was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 시험법의 밸리데이션 및 문서화가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The maintenance of records was inadequate. The electronic system was not validated for its intended use.
finding_text_ko: 기록의 유지관리가 부적절했다. 전자시스템이 의도된 용도에 대해 밸리데이션되지 않았다.

finding_text: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 품질관리부서 책임자의 학력, 경력 및 감독이 부적절했다.

finding_text: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate. The quality control department did not undertake all of the required activities.
finding_text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 양식 및 정확성이 부적절했다. 품질관리부서가 요구되는 모든 업무를 수행하지 않았다.

finding_text: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The premises were not designed, constructed, and/or maintained to prevent the entry of pests and/or foreign material into the building.
finding_text_ko: 사업장이 해충 및 이물질의 건물 내 유입을 방지하도록 설계·건축·유지관리되지 않았다.

finding_text: The ongoing training of personnel was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 작업자에 대한 지속적 교육훈련이 부적절했다.

finding_text: The system for reviewing, revising, and approving standard operating procedures was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 표준작업지침서(SOP)의 검토, 개정, 승인 체계가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The guidelines and/or procedures were inadequate in ensuring storage and/or transportation conditions would maintain the quality and safe distribution of the drug.
finding_text_ko: 보관 및 운송 조건이 의약품의 품질과 안전한 유통을 유지하도록 보장하는 지침 및 절차가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The change control system was inadequate for ensuring changes are properly documented, evaluated, and/or approved.
finding_text_ko: 변경관리(change control) 체계가 변경사항의 적절한 문서화, 평가, 승인을 보장하기에 부적절했다.

finding_text: The temperature and/or humidity control was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 온도 및 습도 관리가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The controls were inadequate for creating, modifying, reviewing, storing, and/or retrieving records. The controls put in place for electronic signatures were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 기록의 생성, 수정, 검토, 보관, 조회에 대한 관리가 부적절했다. 전자서명에 대해 마련된 관리가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate. The job descriptions for personnel, the authority given to personnel, and/or the delegation of duties was inadequate and/or undocumented.
finding_text_ko: 작업자에 대한 GMP 교육훈련 및 기록 유지관리가 부적절했다. 작업자의 직무기술서, 작업자에게 부여된 권한, 업무 위임이 부적절하거나 문서화되지 않았다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.

finding_text: The master production documents were inadequate.

finding_text: The quality control department did not evaluate the results of the annual product quality review.

finding_text: The examination and/or approval of fabrication, packaging, labelling, testing, storage, and/or the transportation method and procedures by the person in charge of the quality control department before implementation was inadequate.

finding_text: The evidence used to demonstrate the transportation and/or storage conditions of each lot or batch of the drug was inadequate.

finding_text: The training of personnel in good manufacturing practices and/or the maintenance of records was inadequate.

finding_text: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 기록의 추적성, 가독성, 문서화, 양식 및 정확성이 부적절했다.

finding_text: The master production documents were inadequate.

finding_text: The recorded information or details were inadequate.

finding_text_ko: 충전 용기에 대한 육안검사(visual inspection)가 부적절했다.

finding_text: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.

finding_text: The handling of raw materials, products, or packaging materials in keeping with pre-approved written procedures or instructions was inadequate.
